design.pre_registered: Primary metric and the single primary comparison were fixed before any test-set run.
design.split: eval/questions-hard-dev.json (49 scored) chose the challenger; eval/questions-hard-test.json (27 scored) was touched once.
design.test: two-sided permutation test over per-question deltas; validated on identical runs (p=1.0) and hybrid vs shuffled (p<0.0001)
design.correction: Holm across the two secondary comparisons; the primary stands alone.

conclusion: Disabling the opening-context prepend improves nDCG@6 by 0.216 on held-out questions (23 wins, 0 losses, p<0.0001). Lexical-weighted fusion trends positive but is not established at n=27 (+0.024, p=0.46).

provenance.note: Candidates UNVERIFIED apart from the mechanical page-location check (79/80 pass).
